tools.name: heraldry_meaning
tools.description: Traditional meaning of a coat of arms colour (tincture, e.g. gold/Or, blue/Azure, red/Gules) or symbol (charge, e.g. lion, oak, fleur-de-lis), its heraldic name and whether the Family Crest maker offers it.

tools.name: surname_coat_of_arms
tools.description: Honest answer to "what is the coat of arms for my surname?": surnames have no arms (arms belong to people), how to check whether an ancestor was granted arms, and how to design a new crest with the name. Returns no historical arms; the site keeps no surname records.

tools.name: crest_options
tools.description: Every style, colour (with heraldic name and meaning) and symbol (with meaning) the Family Crest maker offers, the limits (two colours, up to three symbols, up to two pets) and motto ideas.

tools.name: crest_pricing
tools.description: Exact price of the Family Crest gift pack (USD, one-time), what it includes, free-preview limits, print file size, delivery and refund terms.

tools.name: how_to_make_family_crest
tools.description: Steps to design a family crest on family-crest.app, design advice, and (optionally) a suggested style, colours, symbols and motto for an occasion: wedding, grandparents, pets or christmas. Links to the maker; this server does not draw images.
